name: Nutshell
tagline: Sales CRM for small and midsize teams with pipelines, email tracking, click-to-call and built-in marketing tools.
bestFor: Small B2B sales teams that want sales and marketing in one CRM
description: Nutshell manages contacts, leads and deals in visual pipelines, with two-way Google and Microsoft email sync, sales automation and AI call and meeting summaries. Paid plans start at $13 per user per month billed annually ($19 billed monthly) for Foundation.
pros: Unlimited contacts and storage on every plan
Built-in click-to-call with AI call and meeting summaries on Pro and above
Email open and click tracking for emails sent from Nutshell, with lists sortable by engagement
Free live support on every plan
cons: Foundation is limited to 100 open leads
Sales automation and custom pipelines start at Pro ($42/user/month billed annually)
Two-way SMS, unified inbox and advanced email marketing are paid add-ons (Engagement from $16/user/month, Marketing from $49/month)

plans.name: Foundation
plans.notes: Limit of 100 open leads; 10 AI outcomes/month; unlimited contacts; email and calendar sync; AI chatbot; form builder and landing pages.

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: 20 AI outcomes/month; activity reports, sales quotas, lead assignment rules, custom stage goals, hot leads.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: 40 AI outcomes/month; 5 custom pipelines; sales automation; advanced reporting; AI lead recaps; meeting scheduler; click-to-call and AI call summaries.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: 100 AI outcomes/month; 10 custom pipelines; audit log; email templates from Gmail and Outlook; additional teams and territories.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: 150 AI outcomes/month; unlimited pipelines and custom fields; enterprise SSO; SQL data access; phone support.

integrations: 5,000+ software integrations; two-way Google and Microsoft email and calendar sync
support: Free live support on every plan

name: Insightly
tagline: CRM with lead, opportunity and project management in one system, plus workflow automation and AI Copilot.
bestFor: Teams that hand closed deals off to project delivery
description: Insightly combines lead, contact and opportunity management with project management, kanban pipelines and reports. Plans start at $29 per user per month billed annually for Plus; no monthly-billing price is published.
pros: Project management is included on every plan, including Plus
Kanban view of pipelines on all plans, with stage totals that update as cards are dragged
Phone and email support included for all users
Mobile apps for iOS and Android
cons: Workflow automation, lead routing and AI Copilot require Professional ($49/user/month billed annually)
Pricing page lists only annual billing; no monthly price is published
Email open tracking must be enabled by an admin, works only on paid plans and only for template emails sent from Insightly
trial: 14 days on Plus and Professional, no credit card required

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Billed annually. Lead and contact management, project management, advanced reports, pre-built dashboards.

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: Billed annually. Adds lead assignment and routing, workflow automation and AI Copilot.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Billed annually; purchased through sales. Adds sandboxes, products, pricebooks and quotes, comprehensive audit logging.

integrations: Two-way Gmail and Outlook email sync; AppConnect integration platform sold separately from $249/month for 25,000 tasks
support: Phone and email support for all users (Mon-Fri, 9am-4pm PT)
Premier Support and Success Plan (paid add-on)

name: Bigin by Zoho
tagline: Pipeline-centric CRM from Zoho for small businesses, with a free plan and built-in phone.
bestFor: Very small businesses moving off spreadsheets on a tight budget
description: Bigin is Zoho's lightweight CRM built around team pipelines, with built-in phone, email and WhatsApp integration, and workflow automations on every plan. A free plan covers one user; paid plans start at $7 per user per month billed yearly ($9 billed monthly) for Express.
pros: Free plan includes built-in phone with call recording, automated voice responses and call routing
Workflow automations on every plan (3 on Free, up to 100 on Bigin 360)
Paid plans include phone, email and live chat support plus onboarding and admin training
Native apps for iOS, iPadOS, Android and macOS
cons: Free plan is limited to 1 user, 500 records and one pipeline
AI features (writing assistant, record summary, churn analyzer) start at Premier and run on monthly AI credits
freePlanDetails: Free: 1 user, 500 records, single pipeline, 3 automations, built-in phone, apps for iOS, iPadOS, Android and macOS.
trial: 15 days; afterwards the account moves to the Free plan with no automatic charge

plans.name: Express
plans.notes: 50,000 records, 3 team pipelines, 30 automations, mass emails with email insights, email and WhatsApp integration.

plans.name: Premier
plans.notes: 100,000 records, 5 team pipelines, 50 advanced automations, stage transition rules, sequences, 1,000 AI credits/month.

plans.name: Bigin 360
plans.notes: 1 million records, 15 team pipelines, 100 advanced automation rules, 3,000 AI credits/month, webhooks, 5 GB file cabinet.

integrations: Email and WhatsApp integration; 100+ third-party telephony providers; MCP support
support: Phone, email and live chat (paid plans)
Onboarding, webinars and admin training (paid plans)

name: folk
tagline: Relationship-focused CRM with LinkedIn and Gmail capture, AI assistants and drag-and-drop pipelines.
bestFor: Agencies, founders and small teams that sell through their network
description: folk captures contacts from LinkedIn, Gmail and the web, syncs email, calendar and WhatsApp, and runs AI research, follow-up and workflow assistants. Plans start at $24 per user per month billed yearly ($30 billed monthly) for Standard.
pros: Unlimited contacts on every plan
AI Research, Follow-up and Recap assistants included on all plans
Calls placed from the mobile app are recorded, transcribed and summarised
Native desktop apps for macOS and Windows plus iOS and Android apps
cons: No free plan; the account is blocked after the 14-day trial unless upgraded
Custom objects, deals, dashboards and Zapier/Make apps require Premium ($48/user/month billed yearly)
Standard keeps only the last 30 interactions per contact
trial: 14 days with all premium features, no credit card required

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Unlimited contacts; 500 email finds/month; 2,000 AI fields/month; Workflow Assistant 1,500/month; 2,000 messages/member/month; 1 synced account per member; last 30 interactions per contact.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Custom objects and deals, email sequences, dashboards, Zapier and Make apps, migration service; 1,000 email finds/month; 5,000 AI fields/month; Workflow Assistant 10,000/month; full interaction history.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Starting price, annual billing only. Custom limits, security controls, group-level permissions, priority support, 1:1 onboarding with a dedicated account manager.

integrations: LinkedIn and web capture extension; Gmail, Outlook, calendar and WhatsApp sync; Zapier and Make (Premium and up); MCP server; API

name: monday CRM
tagline: No-code CRM on monday.com's work platform, with customizable pipelines, email tracking and AI agents.
bestFor: Teams already on monday.com that want a customizable no-code CRM
description: monday CRM runs leads, contacts and deals on customizable boards with kanban views, email tracking, automations and AI agents for outreach calls and meeting notes. Plans start at $12 per seat per month billed yearly ($18 billed monthly) for Basic, sold in seat buckets from 3 seats.
pros: Unlimited customizable pipelines and boards
Email tracking with automated rules when a lead receives, opens or replies to an email
Native calling via monday Smart Call from the mobile app, plus an AI outreach caller agent (up to 200 minutes on Basic to Pro)
Native desktop apps for Mac and Windows; 24/7 customer support
cons: Plans start at 3 seats, so the entry cost is at least $36/month billed yearly
Basic caps active contacts and deals at 1,000 and lists no custom automations
Mass emails and email sequences require Pro ($28/seat/month billed yearly)

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Minimum 3 seats. 1 workspace, 1 custom dashboard, 1,000 active contacts and deals, 5 columns per board, 20 quotes and invoices/month, 1,000 API calls/day.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Minimum 3 seats. 3 workspaces, 10,000 active contacts and deals, 15 columns per board, 250 custom automations/month, AI agents, centralized comms hub, iOS and Android apps.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Minimum 3 seats. 15 workspaces, 100,000 active contacts and deals, 75 columns per board, 25K custom automations/month, AI workflow builder, mass emails, email sequences.

plans.name: Ultimate
plans.notes: Custom pricing via sales. Unlimited contacts, deals and workspaces, advanced permissions, HIPAA compliance, 24/7 prioritized support, tailored onboarding, white-glove migration.

integrations: Salesforce, HubSpot, Mailchimp, DocuSign, Aircall, PandaDoc, WhatsApp and other monday.com integrations; MCP server
